# Blitz Utility

<div class="mod-page-icon" markdown="1">

![](../../assets/mods/blitzutility.png)

</div>

Nitoryu, Okama Kenpo, weapon arts and additional Devil Fruits.

Installed build `0.0.6-1.20.1`. [Browse all mods](index.md).

See the [fighting style catalogue](../../characters/styles/index.md) for moves and training.

## Abilities

| In-game name | ID | In-game description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Anti-Admiral Suit | `blitzutility:anti_admiral_suit` | The Kagero armor locks together around the user into the Anti-Admiral Suit, a towering Kairoseki war machine built to fight the three Admirals. Inside it the user takes 25% less damage, takes no fall damage and unlocks Magma Slam, Frost Beam, Light Blasts and Kagero Flight. Granted while wearing the Kagero Gauntlets and Kagero Boots. |
| Axe Damage | `blitzutility:axe_damage` |  |
| Axe Swing Speed | `blitzutility:axe_speed` |  |
| Boot Boosters | `blitzutility:dom_boots_flight` | The Dom Boots' boosters let the user fly while they are above cloud blocks or Neon Green blocks. Granted while wearing the Dom Boots. |
| Boot Dash | `blitzutility:dom_boots_dash` | The Dom Boots' boosters fire and launch the user forward. Above cloud blocks or Neon Green blocks the dash goes twice as far and recharges twice as fast. Granted while wearing the Dom Boots. |
| Call Companions | `blitzutility:call_companions` | Signals every bounty hunter companion you recruited, wherever they are in a loaded area, and brings them to your side. Granted to a guild's Lead Executive and Executives. |
| Chi to Ase to Namida | `blitzutility:chi_to_ase_to_namida` |  |
| Frost Beam | `blitzutility:frost_beam` | The suit's freezing core charges up and unleashes a devastating beam of ice from both gauntlets. Everything in its path gets frostbitten, and every block it lands on is frozen into ice. Requires the Anti-Admiral Suit. |
| Haoshoku Haki: Observation Killer | `blitzutility:observation_killer` | The user unleashes a pulse of Conqueror's Haki that overwhelms the senses of nearby enemies, shutting down any active Kenbunshoku Haki and disabling it for 10 seconds. Enemies without Kenbunshoku Haki active are unaffected. Unlocked with Haoshoku Haki, Kenbunshoku Haki: Future Sight and 90% of the user's maximum haki, along with 9000 doriki. |
| Kagero Flight | `blitzutility:kagero_flight` | The thrusters built into the Kagero Boots carry the Anti-Admiral Suit through the air. Double jump to take off or land. Requires the Anti-Admiral Suit. |
| Light Blasts | `blitzutility:light_blasts` | The suit's light core charges both gauntlets with blinding light. Each swing fires a piercing blast of light from alternating fists that explodes on impact, up to 4 blasts. Requires the Anti-Admiral Suit. |
| Magma Slam | `blitzutility:magma_slam` | The suit's magma core rockets the user into the sky before they crash down fists first like an erupting volcano, burning everyone nearby and leaving a spreading ring of lava and a pool of magma that scorches anyone who stays in it. Requires the Anti-Admiral Suit. |
| Moeru Ryusoken: Kaen Ryuo | `blitzutility:moeru_ryusoken_kaen_ryuo` | Combining Ryusoken with the Mera Mera no Mi, the user grabs the target in a burning dragon claw, spins them through a fiery whirlwind and hurls them away. Requires Ryu no Kagizume, Ryu no Ibuki and the Mera Mera no Mi. |
| Okama Training | `blitzutility:okama_style_bonus` |  |
| Phrase d'armes: Orchestra | `blitzutility:phrase_darmes_orchestra` | The user's next sword strike traces a G-clef through their opponent freezing them solid. Unlocked by mastering the Humming Sword Style with the Yomi Yomi no Mi. |
| Smash Blaster | `blitzutility:smash_blaster` | The Battle Smasher gathers a massive ball of red energy in its fist and hurls it forward. It explodes on contact and levels a huge area. Requires the Battle Smasher. |
| Smash Buster | `blitzutility:smash_buster` | The Battle Smasher's arm seizes the nearest enemy, or whoever you punch, drags them in and crushes them in its grip, disabling their Devil Fruit powers before a point-blank explosion blows them away. Breaks the target's guard. Requires the Battle Smasher. |
| Smash Machine Gun | `blitzutility:smash_machine_gun` | The Battle Smasher's arm unloads a tight, high-velocity stream of red energy shots that tear through armor. Requires the Battle Smasher. |
| Smash Tornado | `blitzutility:smash_tornado` | The Battle Smasher drives its arm into the ground and detonates, splitting the earth and launching everyone around high into the air. Charging widens the blast and makes it hit harder; use it again to release early. Requires the Battle Smasher. |
| Smasher Arm | `blitzutility:smasher_arm` | The Battle Smasher's heavy Kairoseki arm makes every punch hit harder and reach further, and its Kairoseki lets your bare hits strike Logia users through their intangibility. The extra weight slows your swings a little. Active while wearing the Battle Smasher. |
